# Meerkat Manor Network

This folder holds the target network design for Meerkat Manor.

The YAML files under `data/network/` are the source of truth. If a prose document disagrees with the data, the YAML is wrong or the prose is stale. Fix one of them. Do not keep both.

## Document Map

- [Architecture](./architecture.md): zones, trust model, addressing, naming, and service ownership.
- [Physical topology](./physical-topology.md): hardware placement, trunks, access ports, and unmanaged switch limits.
- [DNS and Tailnet](./dns-and-tailnet.md): `home.arpa`, `tail.bigalan.dev`, AdGuard Home, split DNS, MagicDNS, Tailscale SSH, remote NAS access, and Tailscale remote access.
- [Policy and exposure](./policy-and-exposure.md): inter-VLAN rules, service exposure, the TV VLAN VPN path, and `bigalan.dev` publishing through the edge zone.
- [Operations](./operations.md): rollout order, validation, monitoring, backups, and recovery.

## Quick View

| Zone | VLAN | Subnet | Purpose |
| ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- |
| management | 99 | 10.10.99.0/24 | Network infrastructure management |
| server | 10 | 10.10.10.0/24 | Shared services, storage, and compute |
| lan | 20 | 10.10.20.0/24 | Personal trusted devices |
| iot | 30 | 10.10.30.0/24 | Smart home and automation clients |
| guest | 40 | 10.10.40.0/24 | Guest internet only access |
| tv | 50 | 10.10.50.0/28 | Media devices routed through VPN |
| work | 60 | 10.10.60.0/28 | Work devices with explicit internal exceptions only |
## Hard Decisions

- Inter-VLAN traffic is default deny.
- `home.arpa` is the internal DNS suffix.
- AdGuard Home in `VLAN 10` is the primary internal resolver.
- Tailscale uses `grants`, not new ACL work.
- Linux edge and server nodes use Tailscale SSH for admin access. Public SSH stays closed.
- Remote NAS storage is allowed over the tailnet for approved users. `SMB` is the remote file protocol. `NFS` stays internal.
- The Tailscale subnet router lives on a dedicated server-side node, not on the Flint 2.
- Edge servers join the tailnet. Private naming there uses MagicDNS and the private `tail.bigalan.dev` zone, while `home.arpa` stays the split-DNS namespace for homelab services.
- `bigalan.dev` terminates on an edge reverse proxy that joins the tailnet. Public app exposure uses Tailscale as the backhaul, not as the browser-facing DNS or certificate layer.
- Tailnet-only apps use `*.tail.bigalan.dev` instead of `*.ts.net` names. That is private network gating by Tailscale grants, not a substitute for app auth on sensitive services.
- Tailscale Funnel is out of scope for this design.
- The GL-S200 stays on GL.iNet firmware. Its management plane is on `VLAN 99`. Its IoT SSID bridges into `VLAN 30`.

## Platform Baseline

- GL.iNet Flint 2 (`MT6000`): OpenWrt gateway, inter-VLAN firewall, and TV VLAN VPN egress.
- MikroTik CRS310 (`CRS310-8G+2S+IN`): core managed switch.
- GL.iNet Beryl AX (`MT3000`): OpenWrt office AP bridge.
- GL.iNet GL-S200: office Thread and IoT box on GL.iNet firmware.
